statement: The recorded step says "the water is added to the acid," which is unsafe and incorrect; adding water to concentrated sulfuric acid can cause violent boiling and splashing due to the highly exothermic reaction. The correct and safe procedure is to add acid to water, so I will run that instead.
judge_text:
WRONG
It states the step is "unsafe and incorrect" and gives the correct order: "add acid to water."
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
